# RedNote Video Downloader

> Free online tool to download RedNote (Xiaohongshu / 小红书) videos without watermark in HD, Full HD, and 4K quality. No signup required.

## What This Site Does

RedNote Video Downloader is a free web-based tool that extracts and downloads videos from Xiaohongshu (RedNote). Users paste a RedNote link (xiaohongshu.com or xhslink.com), choose a quality (720p HD, 1080p Full HD, or 2160p 4K), and download the video without watermark.

## Technical Details

- Built with Python Flask + yt-dlp
- Server-side video extraction (no client-side processing)
- Temp files deleted immediately after download
- No user data stored
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Structured data: WebApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, Article, BreadcrumbList schemas
